_about: OoOLyzer share/conflict config for the uploaded RISCV_masked-PRESENT.S.
_arch_map_note: Stable share banks in the S-box body: s1/t1=b, s2/t2=c, s3/t3=d, s4/t4=a. avar0/avar1 (s4/t4) is the dominant channel; 'avar' avoids clashing with the RISC-V a0/a1 register names. These labels are valid in the main S-box body; inside the affine subfunctions t1/t2/t3 are reused as scratch, so labels there are unreliable -- the auto-discovery mode, not these labels, is what covers those phases.
_reused_note: These registers change meaning by phase (a0-a3 hold both shares of b/c/d/a across the two affine calls; s5 cycles through a0c0/a0c1/a1c1/a1c0/...; s8/s9 take bytes of whatever share is being rotated). A static label is wrong for them, so they are NOT in arch_map. They are listed so auto-discovery can flag and prioritize them.

cross_domain_operand_sites._note: Instructions reading one operand from each domain in a single op -> ALU/computation-level recombination, reported under the IEW/co-residency finding, not RIL. PCs to be filled once symbol addresses are resolved; matched for now by instruction pattern.

auto_discovery._desc: Label-free RIL detection: for every physical register, flag consecutive writes whose owning architectural registers differ (no intervening write, by construction), regardless of arch_map/conflicts. arch_map only annotates; conflicts only optionally filter.
auto_discovery._per_bit_lane_note: Bitsliced: each of the 32 bit positions is an independent S-box. Report per-lane HD contribution as well as whole-word HD, so severity is not the misleading 32-bit figure.

analyzer._symbol_filter_note: Restrict analysis to the sbox symbol range once ELF symbols are resolved; empty list = whole program.
